title: Psalm 56: I Will Not Fear What Flesh Can Do Unto Me
body:
Read the chapter → [Psalms 56](/bible/psalms/56)

[Psalm 56](/bible/psalms/56) is the confidence of a man daily swallowed up and fought against by many, who resolves to trust the Most High and not fear what flesh can do. The teaching applies this to Christ, whom the scribes and Pharisees followed daily to catch Him in His words, and to the enemies of the truth today who come against IUIC. The answer is the same: put all your trust in the Most High, hold the line, and be a light to your brothers and sisters.

**[Psalms 56:1-4](/bible/psalms/56#v1)**

> <sup>[1](/bible/psalms/56#v1)</sup> Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.
>
> <sup>[2](/bible/psalms/56#v2)</sup> Mine enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O thou most High.
>
> <sup>[3](/bible/psalms/56#v3)</sup> What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
>
> <sup>[4](/bible/psalms/56#v4)</sup> In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.

- He asks for mercy because man would swallow him up, fighting daily and oppressing him, for many fight against him. What time he is afraid, he will trust in the Most High.
- In God he praises His word and puts his trust, and will not fear what flesh can do. This does not mean you never experience fear, but you will not put the fear of man over the fear of God or let it stand between you and the mission.
  - **[Matthew 10:28](/bible/matthew/10#v28)**
    > <sup>[28](/bible/matthew/10#v28)</sup> And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.

    Fear not them that kill the body but cannot kill the soul; rather fear Him who can destroy both soul and body in hell.

**[Psalms 56:5-9](/bible/psalms/56#v5)**

> <sup>[5](/bible/psalms/56#v5)</sup> Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.
>
> <sup>[6](/bible/psalms/56#v6)</sup> They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.
>
> <sup>[7](/bible/psalms/56#v7)</sup> Shall they escape by iniquity? in thine anger cast down the people, O God.
>
> <sup>[8](/bible/psalms/56#v8)</sup> Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?
>
> <sup>[9](/bible/psalms/56#v9)</sup> When I cry unto thee, then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for God is for me.

- Every day they wrest his words and all their thoughts are against him for evil; they gather, hide, and mark his steps, waiting for his soul. This is David in the spirit foreseeing what would happen to Christ.
- He asks whether they shall escape by iniquity, and trusts that the Most High tells his wanderings and keeps his tears in a bottle, and that his enemies shall turn back because God is for him.
  - **[Luke 11:53-54](/bible/luke/11#v53)**
    > <sup>[53](/bible/luke/11#v53)</sup> And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:
    >
    > <sup>[54](/bible/luke/11#v54)</sup> Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.

    The scribes and Pharisees provoked Christ, laying wait to catch something out of His mouth to accuse Him, wicked enough to provoke the Son of the living God.

**[Psalms 56:10-13](/bible/psalms/56#v10)**

> <sup>[10](/bible/psalms/56#v10)</sup> In God will I praise his word: in the Lord will I praise his word.
>
> <sup>[11](/bible/psalms/56#v11)</sup> In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.
>
> <sup>[12](/bible/psalms/56#v12)</sup> Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.
>
> <sup>[13](/bible/psalms/56#v13)</sup> For thou hast delivered my soul from death: wilt not thou deliver my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?

- He praises the word of the Most High and puts his trust in Him, not afraid of what man can do, rendering praises for the vows upon him.
- The Most High delivered his soul from death and will deliver his feet from falling, that he may walk before God in the light of the living. Put all your trust in the Most High.
- People are always trying to come against IUIC, but you hold the line, continue to study, keep the commandments, and be a light unto your brothers even when they walk in wickedness.
